# Acme Corporation Annual Report

This report covers the fiscal year and is organised into a business review, the financial statements, and supporting appendices.
</page_number=1>
<page_number=2>
## Business Review

Demand held up across all three regions, with the strongest growth in the cloud segment. Headcount grew modestly while revenue per employee improved.
</page_number=2>
<page_number=3>
### Cloud Segment

Cloud revenue grew on both new customer additions and expansion within existing accounts. Gross margin improved as capacity utilisation rose.
</page_number=3>
<page_number=4>
### Hardware Segment

Hardware revenue was broadly flat. Component costs eased in the second half, which supported margin recovery.
</page_number=4>
<page_number=5>
## Risk Factors

The principal risks are competitive pressure on pricing, concentration in the top ten customers, and exposure to a small number of component suppliers.
</page_number=5>
<page_number=6>
### Regulatory Environment

Several jurisdictions have proposed rules that would affect data residency. Compliance work is under way but the final requirements are not yet settled.
</page_number=6>
<page_number=7>
# Financial Statements

The statements that follow were prepared under the applicable accounting standards and have been audited.
</page_number=7>
<page_number=8>
## Consolidated Balance Sheet

Total assets rose, driven by cash and contract assets. Liabilities were broadly unchanged and shareholders' equity increased.
</page_number=8>
<page_number=9>
## Consolidated Cash Flow Statement

Operating cash flow exceeded net income. Investing outflows reflected capacity expansion, and financing activity was limited to the buyback programme.
</page_number=9>
<page_number=10>
# Appendix

Definitions of the non-standard measures used in this report, together with reconciliations to the nearest reported figures.
</page_number=10>
